Alex — really glad the demo resonated. High level answers below; I’ve attached a concise price matrix and a pilot SOW skeleton for your procurement team. Ben (AE) and Kim (pricing) are cc’d to help lock details.

Quick summary of options: 
1) 12‑month Reserved + Visibility bundle (recommended for predictability):
   - Baseline: reserved slab priced at X tokens/month for serving + 25% off host rates
   - Add-ons: tracing ingestion & longtail retention packaged as a combined "Visibility Spotlight" SKU (fixed per‑GB slab)
   - Commit credit: 12‑month commit of $Y/month -> we apply a 20% credit to add‑on charges for the first 6 months (phase-in).
2) Pay-as-you-go (flex):
   - No commit; consumption billed monthly at list add-on rates
   - Possible volume tier discounts after crossing monthly thresholds (3T tokens / 5PB retention windows)
3) Hybrid: short pilot commit (30 days, small $ commit) -> pilot credits applied on conversion to annual reserved (one-time applied credit, typically ~10–15% of pilot consumption up to a cap).

Compression / archival mechanics: we offer an archival tier that applies dedup + compression (customer-configurable retention policy). Archive retrieval has a small per‑GB restore fee; in practice customers see 35–60% storage savings depending on signal density. We can include a scheduled batch compaction job to move low‑access spans to compressed archival.

Next steps I propose:
- Ben to confirm the conversion credit math and whether Greenline’s forecast would hit the additional volume breakpoints for bigger discounts.
- Kim to confirm SOW terms we typically use for healthcare pilots (data residency and SOC notes).
- I’ll send the SOW skeleton + price matrix now.

Best,

Alex / team — looping in some concrete numbers so procurement can see options side-by-side. I’ve pulled three worked examples (all in the attached spreadsheet):

A) Conservative pilot -> yearly conversion
   - Pilot: $6k (30 days) creditable toward annual commit
   - Conversion: 12-month commit $72k/year for reserved serving + $18k/year visibility add-ons -> we apply a $3k pilot credit and 12% add-on discount in year 1
B) Midline (likely for teams with steady ingestion)
   - 12-month commit $120k/year -> 18% credit to add-ons first 6 months + archival compression enabled (expected >40% storage reduction)
C) High-volume strategic
   - 24-month commit with staging -> bespoke pricing + volume breakpoint guarantees; we layer in SLO credits for ingestion spikes

Important notes for procurement:
- The pilot credit is additive to any early-conversion incentive we can offer, but caps exist (pilot credit typically <= 25% of pilot committed spend).
- Compression savings are modeled conservatively at 35% in the spreadsheet; we can run a quick sample analysis if you share a week's worth of trace size/ingest rates.
- For healthcare customers, Kim will add the SOC2 / data-residency language to the SOW; any additional attestation (e.g., HITRUST) may change lead times.

If this looks good, Hannah and I can lock a pilot SOW for the 30-day window and schedule a contract review next week.

-Ben
